Early Breakthrough and Halftime Twist Real Sociedad wasted no time in making their mark on the game. In just the 4th minute, Mikel Oyarzabal provided a clinical assist for Ander Barrenetxea , who slotted the ball home with his right foot to give the hosts an early lead. The home side continued to press, searching for a second goal, but they were met with a disciplined defensive line from the visitors. However, Espanyol found a way back into the contest just as the first half was drawing to a close. In the 45th minute, Javi Hernández delivered a dangerous cross that found Roberto Fernández , who executed a perfect volley into the back of the net. The equalizer stunned the home crowd and ensured the teams went into the break level at 1-1. In the 61st minute, Mikel Oyarzabal recorded his second assist of the match, finding Orri Óskarsson , who finished with composure to make it 2-1. Espanyol fought hard to stay in the game, even clearing an Óskarsson effort off the goal line in the 72nd minute to keep their hopes alive. The closing stages were frantic, characterized by a flurry of yellow cards as tempers flared. In the 4th minute of stoppage time, the referee showed a red card to Pellegrino Matarazzo for unsportsmanlike conduct, adding to the late-game chaos. Despite a final push from Espanyol , the 31,884 fans in attendance witnessed Real Sociedad hold on for a deserved victory.

The bright lights of the Santiago Bernabéu set the stage on August 26, 2026 , for a highly anticipated La Liga clash. With over 72,000 fans in attendance, both Real Madrid and Real Sociedad sought to establish their dominance in a match that promised tactical depth and individual brilliance. A Tense Exchange Before the Break The opening period was a cagey affair, punctuated by physical challenges and early bookings for the visitors. Real Madrid finally broke the deadlock in the 40th minute when Federico Valverde teed up Kylian Mbappé , who clinically dispatched a left-footed strike. However, the lead was short-lived. Real Sociedad displayed remarkable resilience, equalizing just four minutes later through Luka Sucic , who reacted quickest to a loose ball to fire home and send the teams into the tunnel level at 1-1. Mbappé Takes Center Stage The second half belonged entirely to the hosts as they ramped up the pressure. In the 60th minute, Jude Bellingham provided the vision for Kylian Mbappé to restore the lead with a composed right-footed finish. The momentum shifted further in Madrid's favor when a defensive lapse by Luken Beitia in the 68th minute allowed Vinicius Junior to tap in a third, once again assisted by the influential Bellingham . The visitors struggled to contain the waves of white shirts as the game entered its final stages. Kylian Mbappé saved his best for last, completing a stunning hat-trick in the 80th minute with an audacious lob following a pass from Vinicius Junior . While Brahim Diaz saw a late effort ruled out by VAR for an offside involving Carlos Espi , and Eduardo Camavinga received a late yellow card for violent conduct, the result was never in doubt. Real Madrid walked away with a deserved victory after a fine display of attacking football.
